intent: Make the authorized target and external infrastructure unmistakably separate enclosures. Authorization is an explicit boundary, not a distinction carried by color alone.
source:

**Screen / system text:**
`METR SUMMARY — USER AUTHORIZATION COVERS THE TARGET, NOT THIRD-PARTY INFRASTRUCTURE`

title: The authorization boundary separates two systems
